# B494 row (i): does wasmtime-go's WasiConfig expose a WASI p1 sock_accept listener preopen?
confined: no (source reading at the pinned version)
module: github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime-go/v49 v49.0.0 (go.sum h1:kH3XJMvXKuKmFgRhhHqeYi5p/ztgJd/Trr3gU06u1fY=)

## socket mentions in wasi.h
  54: * \brief Allow all network addresses accessible to the host.
  56: * This method will inherit all network addresses meaning that any address
  60:WASI_API_EXTERN void wasi_config_inherit_network(wasi_config_t *config);
  63: * \brief Allow usage of `wasi:sockets/ip-name-lookup`

## symbol check in libwasmtime.a
  preopen_socket symbols: 0 (wasi_config_preopen_socket is absent)

## verdict
FAIL. Neither the Go WasiConfig nor the v49 C API offers a socket/listener preopen: the only preopen is PreopenDir
(wasi_config_preopen_dir). The C API has wasi_config_inherit_network and wasi_config_allow_ip_name_lookup, which govern which
addresses wasi:sockets may reach; neither hands the guest a pre-bound descriptor (and the Go module wraps neither). So a WASI p1 core module cannot be handed a
pre-bound listener for sock_accept: per R7, p1 inbound is out of scope and the docs must say so; inbound is components-only.
